connections.why: Multimedia is encoded using the binary number systems
Storage is measured and compressed in binary units
Data is sent as the binary patterns just studied
Error checks verify the transmitted bit patterns
Encryption protects data as it is transmitted
The CPU processes the binary data representations
Processors are built from Boolean logic gates
System software manages and controls the hardware
Physical storage media hold the compressed data
Network hardware connects devices to the internet
The internet relies on these transmission methods
Encryption is a core cyber-security measure
Digital currency is exchanged over the internet
Many automated systems are connected over networks
AI is advanced software built on these foundations
Programs are written in languages and run through translators
Designed algorithms are implemented as program code
Arrays store sets of related values in a program
Programs read and write data using file handling
Databases store values using the underlying data types
Programs query and update data held in databases
Robots are automated systems with sensors and actuators
